contents: TIP_COMMIT; branch bundle (income-headroom successor tip 2af3c9db2..research/pcrl-occupation-headroom-overnight-v1); code.tar (git archive of ohn, ihs and the lineage code and the public records the check needs); private.tar (this campaign's private tree: releases, development evaluations, reader-grid caches and summaries, deployment packages, compute ledger and unit logs, access logs, admitted logs; plus the verified source mirror .private/pcrl_income_headroom_successor_v1 that the ohn code reads); MANIFEST.sha256; RESTORE_CHECK.json
restore_check: from the backup alone (ohn.custody): manifest re-hash; git bundle verify; extraction of code.tar and private.tar into a fresh directory; there, with the restored code (ohn.restore_check): re-hash of the 201 admitted mirror copies against SOURCE_ADMISSION.json, every occupation release record (OCC.json -> OCC.npz) and complete release record (RELEASE.json -> RELEASE.npz), and redeployment of every package under runs/DEPLOY on the restored DEV_REPORT raw inputs (no labels) compared bitwise with the restored evaluated releases through the wrapper API, the CSV path and the underlying function, with every refusal. Interpreter: the local Homebrew python3 (3.14.3, numpy 2.4.4, scikit-learn 1.8.0).

same_device_backups.label: B1 (before closeout; used for the independent verifier's restored-copy check)
same_device_backups.read_back: same device (local disk); not an off-device or cold check
same_device_backups.independent_restored_copy_check: the independent verifier extracted B1 into a fresh scratch directory, ran its own v_deploy.py with the restored root's own code on all 38 packages (own raw-field encoder, wrapper / CSV / underlying bitwise against the restored DEV_REPORT release, refusal battery, runtime-read trace) and removed the extracted copy: all_ok true (roles/verifier/records/VER_DEPLOY_RESTORED.json)

same_device_backups.label: B2 (final, after the closeout receipts; the custody copy of record)
same_device_backups.read_back: same device (local disk); not an off-device or cold check
same_device_backups.note: commits after the tip (this record, the publication record) are not in this backup; they live on the local research branch

off_device.reason: no external backup drive attached at closeout (/Volumes holds only the system volume and two mounted application installer images, not backup drives); nothing was mounted, unmounted or forced
off_device.command: python3 -m ohn.custody offdevice <same-device backup dir> /Volumes/<external drive>/pcrl_backups
